ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that: $OA\perp OB$, $\angle BOC=50^\circ$, and $\angle AOD : \angle COD=4 : 7$. Draw the angle bisector OE of $\angle BOC$, and find the degree measure of $\angle DOE$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure:\\
Since OA$\perp$OB,\\
It follows that $\angle$AOB=$90^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle$AOD$\colon$ $\angle$COD=4$\colon$ 7,\\
Let $\angle$AOD=$4x^\circ$ and $\angle$COD=$7x^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle$AOB+$\angle$AOD+$\angle$COD+$\angle$BOC=$360^\circ$, and $\angle$BOC=$50^\circ$,\\
It follows that $90+7x+4x+50=360$,\\
Thus, $x=20$,\\
Therefore, $\angle$COD=$140^\circ$.\\
Since OE is the bisector of $\angle$BOC,\\
It follows that $\angle COE=\frac{1}{2}\angle$BOC=$25^\circ$,\\
Therefore, $\angle$DOE=$\angle$COD+$\angle$COE=\boxed{165^\circ}.
